pass_marks.variants: at least 10 forward sessions and 100 trades, total change > 0 and better than live on at least 60% of days
pass_marks.gates: at least 30 blocked trades over 8+ days, forward change if enforced > 0 and it helped on at least 60% of the blocked days
pass_marks.rule: READY only means the mark is met. Nothing goes live without the user's explicit yes.
